checks.label: A second live worker cannot price the same email

checks.label: An expired worker cannot write after a retry takes over

checks.detail: Deferred parsing keeps the assignment lock and leaves terminal request states untouched.

checks.label: A stopped price read removes partial rows and keeps the candidate
